_meta.description: Copy and labels for the Contact page.

en.title: Contact
en.description: Share a short note below. Your device will open the default mail app so that no third-party service stores the message.
notes: For academic connections and conversations about shared research interests, please get in touch.

feedback.emailMissing: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL_B64 before deploying so the email can be revealed.
feedback.formInvalid: Fill out all fields before opening your mail client.

calloutPoints: The form opens a draft in your email app. Review it and send it from there.
You can also reveal or copy the email address to use your preferred email service.
